mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in real GDP signals a strong economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following positive GDP growth, or GDP growth explains < 10% of SPX return variation over any 3-year window (R^2 < 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate signals a rapidly weakening economy that will pressure corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 0.5pp+ rise in UNRATE, or the signal explains < 5% of return variation in high-unemployment regimes (R^2 < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production signals a supply shock that will drive inflation and compress S&P 500 margins, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 50% of months following a 2%+ YoY drop in INDPRO, or the signal explains < 10% of return variation in supply shock regimes (R^2 < 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary cycle that will pressure equity valuations and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 0.5pp+ rise in FEDFUNDS, or the signal explains < 5% of return variation in tightening cycles (R^2 < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in retail sales signals a weakening consumer sector that will pressure corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 2%+ YoY drop in RSAFS, or the signal explains < 10% of return variation in consumer slowdown regimes (R^2 < 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in payroll employment signals a tightening labor market that will boost wage inflation and pressure S&P 500 margins, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 50% of months following a 300k+ YoY rise in PAYEMS, or the signal explains < 10% of return variation in labor market overheating regimes (R^2 < 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in housing starts signals a booming housing sector that will boost economic activity and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following a 10%+ YoY rise in HOUST, or the signal explains < 10% of return variation in housing boom regimes (R^2 < 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in CPI inflation signals a loss of purchasing power that will erode consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 50% of months following a 3%+ YoY rise in CPIAUCSL, or the signal explains < 10% of return variation in high-inflation regimes (R^2 < 0.10).
